milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the barrel and face it to demonstrate they have found it. The barrel is placed at spawn-relative (2, 0, 3) on a cobblestone platform ~3.6 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 ensures the player is in the vicinity, and facing_tolerance=60° ensures they are actually looking toward the barrel (confirming visual identification).
